newsitem.title: UK: Fairfax spends $420 mln to create major reinsurer.
newsitem.headline: Fairfax spends $420 mln to create major reinsurer.

text.p: Canada's Fairfax Financial Group has committed $420 million to the acquisition of Sphere Drake and plans to form a major new player in the reinsurance sector with capital of $900 million.

Centre Capital Investments, Electra Investment Trust and Dai-Tokyo International Company Ltd, which together own 40 per cent of Sphere Drake shares, have agreed to vote in favour of the transaction, a spokesman told Reuters on Monday.

Holders of the company's 18,381,361 shares will receive approximately $140 million in cash and another $180 million in ten years or less, subject to reserve adequacy, reinsurance recoverables and indemnities.
